svg.title: reflex-whoop
svg.desc: iOS. BLE live heart rate. Keeps WHOOP data on your phone: syncs the WHOOP API and reads live heart rate straight from the band over read-only Bluetooth, into an archive that outlives the subscription. Built with Swift, SwiftUI, Core Bluetooth, GRDB.

g.text: Keeps WHOOP data on your phone: syncs the WHOOP API and
reads live heart rate straight from the band over read-only
Bluetooth, into an archive that outlives the subscription.
